lastSession.summary: Implemented marky-yo7: link_scan SIMD kernel. Uses @Vector(16, u8) to find '[' characters, then scalar state machine for bracket nesting, escaped brackets, paren-depth URL parsing, and wiki-link pipe splitting. Handles [text](url), [[target]], [[target|display]], ![alt](url). 77/77 Zig tests pass (26 new). SIMD ~1.9x speedup. Library exports 5 symbols. Committed d6bb46a.
